project_type: Next.js 16 App Router (Server Actions) + React 19 + TypeScript (strict) tennis-tournament app 'GRAN'. Feature-based modular monolith under src/features/<f>/{components,hooks,server,types,utils}.
language: TypeScript 5.7.2 (strict: true, target ES2017, moduleResolution bundler, paths @/* -> ./src/*). any is forbidden (regulation §3.1).
build_system: npm scripts. next build. No DI container / ORM to be added (design §1 lock). DB client is node:sqlite DatabaseSync (globalThis singleton in src/lib/db.ts).
test_framework: vitest@3 (fast-check@3 for property tests). Config vitest.config.ts: include src/**/__tests__/**, fileParallelism:false (single fork, serial). Tests live in __tests__/ next to the code under test.
test_command: npm test  (== vitest --run). Scoped: npx vitest run <path>
verification_instructions: Per design §10/§11 each phase must keep ALL THREE green: (1) npm test, (2) npx tsc --noEmit, (3) npm run build. BASELINE CONFIRMED by planning step: npm test = 43 passed / 12 files, 0 failed; tsc --noEmit exit 0; the carryover-flagged dataRepository.results.test.ts Property 7 PASSED on 3 separate runs (the 'pre-existing red' claim did NOT reproduce — treat as flaky fast-check, do not newly break it). CAVEAT: npm run build currently FAILS ONLY with SQLite 'database is locked' (errcode 261) at src/lib/db.ts:44 during Next page-data collection, because 3 node.exe dev/watcher processes started ~13:48 hold the data/gran.db WAL lock. This is an ENVIRONMENT lock, not a code regression. To verify build, ensure no dev server holds data/gran.db (or run build when the lock is free); do NOT kill the user's node processes without asking. If build cannot run due to the lock, record that tsc+tests are green and the build blocker is the external lock.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build/test. next build writes .next/ (gitignored). data/gran.db (+ -wal/-shm) is a local SQLite file created by src/lib/db.ts on first import; do not commit it and do not change its schema.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. 3 node.exe processes (dev servers/watchers) are running and hold a WAL lock on data/gran.db, which makes `next build` fail with 'database is locked' until released. tsc and vitest are unaffected. Never modify git config; commit locally only, never push. Prefer staging specific files.
contribution_requirements: Regulation .github/Antigravity-instructions.md: §1.2 one-way dependency app->features->components/lib/types/utils AND no direct cross-feature internal imports (share via root components/types/utils, or — per design §1.2 extension — the NEW roots src/domain, src/lib/unitOfWork, src/server/container). §2 naming (dirs kebab-case; types PascalCase, no I/T prefix; utils camelCase verb+noun; Zod schema camelCase+Schema; booleans is/has/can/should; db snake_case). §3.1 no any (use unknown+Zod). §6 SQL confined to repository/infrastructure layer. §7 early return + safe error messages (no DB/stack to client). Behavior-preserving: do NOT change user-visible behavior, DB schema (src/lib/db.ts CREATE TABLE/CHECK/UNIQUE/INDEX/NOW_JST), or Server Action external contracts (names, args, return shapes EntryActionResult/AuthActionState/MyEntriesResult/DataViewData). Commits: Conventional Commits, one commit per feature (e.g. refactor(entries): ...).
key_patterns: Backend today = module-level pure functions + repository functions. Target (design docs/oop-architecture.md): rich Entity / Value Object / Domain Service (classes) + Repository interface in domain/ with Sqlite<Entity>Repository impl in infrastructure/ + Application Service (use-case orchestration, owns transaction boundary via SqliteUnitOfWork) + thin 'use server' adapter in actions.ts. Errors: domain throws typed DomainError subclasses; adapter's pure toActionResult(error, context?) maps to user-facing Result (wording must be 1-byte identical to current actions.ts). Transaction boundary moves from repository BEGIN IMMEDIATE into Application Service UoW.run(). CRITICAL boundary rule: never pass class instances/methods across 'use server' — reads return plain DTOs (EntrySummary, EntryMemberView, TournamentWithStats.remaining/capacityStatus), writes use entities internally only. CARRYOVER (design-review.json still CHANGES_REQUESTED, A MEDIUM / B,C NIT — must be closed before pilot): A) permission judgement goes in the Application Service for ALL FOUR use cases (submit/submitWaitlist/cancel/updateMembers) via injected TeamRepository, same wording/branches relocated; B) regulation §2 directory-naming annotation for domain/application/infrastructure in final-doc step; C) pseudocode fetch sites — user=this.users.findById(cmd.userId), team=this.teams.findById(cmd.teamId), role=user.role, isAdmin=user.isAdmin, policy=new CancelFeePolicy().
